moshi_turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?
Get off the high ground as fast as you safely can. Ridges and summits are the worst places to be.
Avoid lone trees and metal fences, and spread out if you're in a group. Crouch low on your pack, feet together, rather than lying flat.
Lying flat puts more of your body in contact with the ground, where current can travel. Crouching keeps that smaller.
It is, but rare if you plan well. Check the forecast, and if storms are likely in the afternoon, be off the tops by lunchtime.
